lines.en: One hop and my metal shell clangs.
Sparks under me; I slide forward.
I hug the wall and creep closer.
My green light blinks on and off.
I move slowly, afraid to beep early.
Every step muffles my ticking.
I go around the rocks so I do not trip.
The wind sways my fuse.

lines.zh: 我拖着短腿，追着影子走。
lines.en: Short legs, chasing a shadow.
My plating scrapes the ground.
Bit by bit I creep into range.
I already planned the route.
Grass scorches where I step.
Do not look back; I am right behind you.

lines.zh: 我挪一步，红灯就亮一下。
lines.en: One step, and the red lamp blinks once.

lines.zh: 铁壳里的小齿轮转得很响。
lines.en: The little gears inside my shell grind loud.
Beep, beep, I try to stay quiet.
I crouch in a corner counting seconds.
My fuse is damp; I shake it.
Powder rumbles in my belly.
I watch the crossing, waiting for someone.
The light went out; saving power?
I tighten one of my bolts.
The sun heats my metal shell.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，虽然不用呼吸。
lines.en: I hold my breath, though I do not breathe.
Behind this tree is a good spot.
Counted to ten again; still nobody.

lines.zh: 静静待着，也是一种埋伏。
lines.en: Waiting quietly is its own ambush.
Did you hear that beeping?
I look up only to judge the distance.
Your face is far too close.
I am counting your blinks.
Do not stare at my fuse.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我壳上，逼近了。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell, closing in.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就少响一声。
lines.en: One step back and I beep once less.
I saw your grip tighten on the sword.
Your eyes have a reflection: me.

lines.zh: 看清楚了吗？我要开始了。
lines.en: Had a good look? I am starting now.
My shell cracked; do not touch it.
It hurts, but I dare not cry out.
My fuse got soaked.
You knocked my light crooked.
Powder leaks through the crack.
That hit moved my schedule up.
My wheel stopped turning.
Stop hitting me; I will blow.
The dent muffles my beeping.

lines.zh: 我还没到目标就散架了。
lines.en: I am falling apart before reaching the target.
Let me smell that pouch of powder.

lines.zh: 是 TNT 吗？我认得那味道。
lines.en: Is that TNT? I know that smell.

lines.zh: 你把火药放低点，我够不着。
lines.en: Lower the powder; I cannot reach.
May I chew that fuse?
I only want a pinch of powder.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的是炸药包吧？
lines.en: Is that a charge on your belt?
Give me powder and I will stay quiet.
That smell makes my shell itch.
I will trade scrap iron for powder.
Do not go; I follow that smell.
One bump and my fuse wobbles.
Do not push; I am close to going off.
Your bump lit my light.
A dent in my shell.
I rolled half a turn before stopping.
You stepped on my wheel.
Easy; the powder will spill.
Bump me again and I cannot hold it.
I bounce back into a rock.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就要开始响了。
lines.en: One step closer and I start to beep.

lines.zh: 兵工厂里，我们是一批的。
lines.en: We came from the same arsenal batch.
You beep once, I beep once.
We count to three together.
Your fuse is longer than mine.
Standing together makes us braver.

lines.zh: 谁先炸，另一个就接着上。
lines.en: Whoever blows first, the other follows.
We take turns guarding this crossing.

lines.zh: 你的灯是蓝的，我是绿的。
lines.en: Your light is blue; mine is green.
Stay together; we are scarier as a pair.
Next life, same batch.
A lump of powder on the ground; mine.
This fuse is still usable.
Scrap iron for me; it patches my shell.
Who dropped this flint?
I pick it up and stuff it in my belly.
This nail fits my seam.
Even powder dust I will take.
Do not step on it; I saw it first.
I hide the loot under my shell.
Once I pick this up, I go.
I see you; the countdown starts.
Target in range; I speed up.
You stand in the open; excellent.
My light just turned red.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我锁定了。
lines.en: I locked onto the iron smell on you.
The one behind that door.

lines.zh: 我不需要瞄准，只要靠近。
lines.en: No aiming needed; I only need to get close.
You cannot outrun me; I did the math.
Three of you; I take the nearest.
Five blocks away; close enough.

lines.zh: 滴答越来越快，你听见没？
lines.en: The ticking quickens; hear it?

lines.zh: 我压着脚步，一点点逼近。
lines.en: I creep closer, step by step.

lines.zh: 墙角没有退路，滴滴声近了。
lines.en: No way out of this corner; the beeping nears.
I am waiting for you to turn.
I memorized the blast radius.
Two fingers of fuse left.

lines.zh: 你举盾也挡不住这声滴。
lines.en: A shield won't stop this beep.
I stick to you; nowhere to run.
At zero, I stop being polite.
Do not reach out; it will set me off early.
A little bump to warm up.
That one does not count; the big one is coming.
I ram your knee with my shell.
Do not think all I do is explode.
Sparks splash your legs.
I bite down on your greaves.
Hurts? It gets worse.
I knock your shield aside.
Beep, beep — I count to three.
Swing again and I press in.

lines.zh: 兵工厂的传送带停了，我掉下来。
lines.en: The arsenal belt stopped and I dropped out.
I wake with a red light blinking.
A serial number still stamped on my shell.
Does this place need clearing?
Fresh fuse, never trimmed.
I roll out of a wooden crate.
Someone flipped my switch.
Powder loaded; ready to go anytime.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见自己的滴答声。
lines.en: First time I hear my own ticking.
My shell says: get close.
Flame runs up my fuse.
I fell and my shell crumpled.
Water floods my shell and soaks the powder.

lines.zh: 别人的爆炸把我掀翻了。
lines.en: Another blast flips me over.
An arrow wedges into my seam.
My beeping sticks in my throat.
Low on powder, I feel sluggish.
Lightning strikes; my light flickers wildly.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的滴答没有回声。
lines.en: In the void, my ticking has no echo.
